guard: Private version-one bootstrap document decoding rejects inconsistent or widened material without creating keys, connecting or authenticating admission
why: The source-root export parses actual private carrier bytes produced from stock host-minted credentials. Hostile inputs are serialized independently rather than prechecked with the parser's canonicalizer. A private owned native broker proves valid authentication, raw auth-store denial and rejection of a forged signature that intentionally still passes local consistency. This is library/crypto/broker proof, not file custody, admission, WSS trust, bootstrap RPC or hosted execution. Source imports consume changed code directly; no compiled mutant copy is built by this command.
